host: AWS EC2 m7i.8xlarge, Xeon Platinum 8488C, 32 vCPU = 16 physical cores x 2 SMT threads, 123 GiB, us-east-2
ceiling_cpu_method: 20 bare python:3.13-slim processes looping fibo(31) for 12s with the engine stopped: 138.3/s. 16 processes give 137.1/s, so SMT adds ~1% and the real limit is 16 physical cores, not the 20 slots.

concurrency.stock: 20 worker containers, one job at a time each
concurrency.dedicated: 20 dedicated worker containers bound to the script, warm process

caveat: for dedicated jobs duration_ms includes assignment, so interval-overlap concurrency overstates it (reads 82); effective concurrency = throughput x task duration
